# Regenerating this guide {#admin-guide-regeneration}

This guide is generated content. Its per-tool reference pages derive
from the tool manifest and the packaged tools' interfaces; prose parts
are revised by pull request.

The regeneration contract, in plain terms:

- A page states the **exact tool version it was written against** —
  the pin that produced it — so every page is bound to a version.
- When a package bump or a release moves a tool's version, that
  tool's page is **regenerated in the same change**, enforced by the
  repository's coverage and provenance checks.
- Nothing is hand-patched on a generated page: upstream interface
  drift is answered by regeneration, not by editing.

The pipeline pages and the CI gate that enforce these rules land in
the 2026.01 window; until then the reference section (Part III) is
held back rather than published unverified.
